entities.name: Jacobus Josephus Eeckhout

entities.summary: Jacobus Josephus Eeckhout or Jacques Joseph Eeckhout was a Flemish painter, sculptor, pastellist, water-colourist and lithographer and a Director of the Royal Academy of Art in The Hague.
